shortFormVideos.title: The Overdrive Film
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: How the Top Speed network works, in one short film.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: One booking moves through the whole Top Speed Appliance network: book online or with Speedy AI, Service Setters dispatch, Company Techs and vetted network providers, live Track My Tech, and a finished repair backed by a 90-day parts & labor warranty.

shortFormVideos.title: Overdrive — Guided Arrival
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: Full-screen GPS navigation, then the tech sets up to work.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: The Top Speed van follows GPS navigation to the customer address, then the technician sets up tools to begin the repair.

shortFormVideos.title: Overdrive — The Greeting
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: The tech arrives and meets the customer at the door.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: A Top Speed technician arrives at the customer home and greets the customer at the front door before going to the appliance.

shortFormVideos.title: Overdrive — The Branded Crew
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: The wrapped van and the uniform: the crew, on brand.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: The Top Speed Appliance van in its navy and red racing livery, and the technician uniform carrying the logo.

shortFormVideos.title: Overdrive — The Repair
shortFormVideos.shortDescription: Diagnostics at work: a refrigerator fan motor, found and fixed.
shortFormVideos.longDescription: Real diagnostics: speedometer, GPS-guided van, meeting the customer, and diagnosing a refrigerator fan motor inside the freezer back panel.
